meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 装上后，它会启动一个5人对抗式辩论：五个成员互相攻击方案里的漏洞、过度设计和未经验证的假设，只留下经得起攻击的要点，再交给专门的规划器整理成正式计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”等触发词，或提出需要超高严谨度、检查弱假设和过度设计时，它就会接管。

say.text: 用hpp检查我这个方案的漏洞
say.note: 团队会互相攻击找薄弱点

say.text: 进入对抗式规划，审视我的假设和过度设计
say.note: 只有经得起攻击的观点会进计划

howto.what_en: Claude runs a 5-member adversarial debate: the members attack each other's findings for flaws, over-engineering, and unverified assumptions; only insights that survive are passed to a planner task (ulw-plan) to be formalized into an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', etc., or when planning needs maximum rigor to surface weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this project.
say_en.note: Claude debates first, then produces the plan.

say_en.text: Use hpp to find holes in my proposal.
say_en.note: The team attacks each other to surface weak points.

say_en.text: Enter adversarial planning to check my assumptions and over-engineering.
say_en.note: Only attack-surviving insights make it into the plan.
